projects.title: Insurance Company Software
projects.description: This is a generic software built for an insurance company. Its main purpose is to keep records of transactions done through the day. Management can add profiles of companies, policy types, team members, customers, payouts, call logs, and transactions. From the inputted data the program is able to generate receipts, and range date reports. Also, the software is flexible to accept domain based authentication as well as SQL Server authentication with a time lapse expiration upon idle.

projects.title: Text Message System
projects.description: From a list of phones provided, I created a back end technology that sends bulk text messages. The program is able to send custom reminders at a scheduled time. It lists any phone numbers that replies to the non-send group. Also, using Code First Entity Framework, the program is able to create an empty a non-send group database if it doesn't exists.
